queries.title: Search queries
queries.description: One search feed per query. Google News operators work: site:reuters.com, intitle:word, "exact phrase", OR, -exclude, when:7d.

topics.title: Topic sections
topics.description: Optional. One topic feed per selected section.

topHeadlines.title: Top headlines
topHeadlines.description: Also read the top-headlines feed for the chosen language and country.

language.title: Language
language.description: Google News language code (hl), e.g. en, de, fr, ja, pt-419.

country.title: Country
country.description: Two-letter country code (gl), e.g. US, GB, DE, JP.

timeRange.title: Time range
timeRange.description: Applies to search queries only. Implemented by appending 'when:1d' etc. to each query.

after.title: Published after
after.description: Search queries only. Appended to each query as 'after:YYYY-MM-DD'.

before.title: Published before
before.description: Search queries only. Appended to each query as 'before:YYYY-MM-DD'.

maxItemsPerQuery.title: Max items per query
maxItemsPerQuery.description: Upper limit per feed. A Google News feed returns at most about 100 items.

dedupe.title: Remove duplicates
dedupe.description: Return each article link only once per run, even if several queries match it.
